summary: One test executed and failed due to the contact form element not being found and visible on the page.
rootCause: The test failed because the locator 'form[data-test="contact-form"]' did not find any matching element on the page within the timeout period, causing the visibility assertion to fail.

failedTests.testName: TC-001: Verify accessibility of the contact form
failedTests.errorMessage: expect(locator('form[data-test="contact-form"]').toBeVisible()) failed: element(s) not found within 5000ms timeout.
failedTests.likelyCause: Selector used in the test does not match any element in the application at the time of test execution.
failedTests.recommendation: Verify that the selector 'form[data-test="contact-form"]' is correct and that the contact form is rendered on the /contact page. Update the selector if the application markup has changed or ensure the page loads the form correctly before the assertion.

recommendations: Review the application page at the URL `${baseUrl}/contact` to confirm the presence and correct attribute of the contact form element.
Check if recent application changes affected the form's data-test attribute or its visibility.
If the selector is correct, investigate potential timing issues or page load delays and consider increasing the timeout or adding waits.
Ensure the test environment is correctly set up and the application is deployed with the expected UI elements.
releaseImpact: High - The failure indicates a critical UI element (contact form) is not accessible or not detected, which may block user interactions and affect release quality.
